machine.name: localai/digital_logic_baseline
machine.description: Digital logic domain state classifier, generated from domains/domain-manifest.json by scripts/generate_domain_machines.py — do not edit by hand. Reads the worst-state-wins roll-up that localAIStack writes at [7672:7676] as a one-hot [thriving, balanced, watch, attention] and asserts the matching state at [7676:7680]. All sequences are isInitial under PASSTHROUGH; the input is one-hot, so at most one fires per step, and an all-zero input (nothing graded) fires digital_logic-none, which retracts the output to all zero.

metadata.author: localAIStack domain-machine generator
metadata.eventSpace: 4D roll-up one-hot at [7672:7676]: [thriving, balanced, watch, attention], written by localAIStack (sensor localai_digital_logic_rollup)

localai_digital_logic_rollup.description: Worst-state-wins roll-up over the graded digital logic measures, one-hot; all zero when nothing is graded. Declared inactive, active on its first value.

stateLogic.thriving: Every graded measure in the digital logic domain is in its nominal range.
stateLogic.balanced: Exactly one graded measure in the digital logic domain is slightly outside its nominal range, none well outside.
stateLogic.watch: Two or more graded measures in the digital logic domain are slightly outside their nominal ranges, none well outside.
stateLogic.attention: At least one graded measure in the digital logic domain is well outside its nominal range.
stateLogic.none: Nothing graded — the roll-up is all zero; digital_logic-none retracts the output to all zero
stateLogic.mutualExclusivity: The roll-up is one-hot, so no two sequences fire in the same step

localAIPromptHints.thriving: Every digital logic measure in scope is in its nominal range.
localAIPromptHints.balanced: One digital logic measure in scope is slightly outside its nominal range. A gentle nudge is enough.
localAIPromptHints.watch: Several digital logic measures in scope are slightly outside their nominal ranges. Suggest an easier day and attention to the basics.
localAIPromptHints.attention: At least one digital logic measure in scope is well outside its nominal range. Recommend a check-in.
